title: Why hasn't my direct deposit arrived yet?
summary: This document explains why a direct deposit may not have arrived yet: verify it isn’t in your account, confirm with the direct deposit payer, and ask the bank if the deposit was rejected. It notes deposits can take up to 3 days and describes a temporary hold of Yes on part of the paycheck after posting.
